NoSQLServer v0.78 validation
Date: 2026-08-23
Runtime: Open Object Rexx 5.3.0 r13196, 64-bit debug build
House dependency: Alchemy Objects v0.5.1
House standard: ALCHEMY-HOUSE-OBJECT-0.5
Crypto dependency: oorexx_crypto_v0.1
Unicode dependency: TUTOR 0.7 only when explicitly enabled

New acceptance
--------------
  tests/v078_alchemy_adoption_smoke.rex                         PASS
  tests/v077_alchemy_object_base_smoke.rex                      PASS

The v0.78 adoption smoke proves:
  - File/Object/JSON/SQLite/GeoPackage/Federated engines inherit AlchemyObject
  - SQL executor, transaction and Database Core adapter satisfy STANDARD adoption
  - v0.5.1 permits the existing NoSQLServerSQL~version business API
  - required STANDARD metadata is present at the NoSQL house boundary
  - default/unsecured objects remain STANDARD-ready
  - SECURE_READY is not implied without host sealer/capability configuration
  - capabilities ALCHEMY_OBJECT_BASE_0_5_1 and
    ALCHEMY_OBJECT_STANDARD_0_5 are advertised

Known SQL frontier remains unchanged
------------------------------------
  Hell v1: DISTINCT + ORDER BY non-projected aggregate          PARSE_ERROR
  Hell v2: LATERAL joins                                        PARSE_ERROR
  Hell v2: MERGE                                                 UNSUPPORTED
  Hell v2: recursive SEARCH/CYCLE                                UNSUPPORTED
  No wrong-result oracle regression is introduced by v0.78.

Architecture boundary
---------------------
Alchemy Objects is applied to long-lived service/state objects only. Relational
rows, scalar values, geometry objects, parser/expression nodes and other hot-path
data remain lightweight. Alchemy identity/telemetry/evidence is infrastructure,
not SQL/provider/legal authority.

Packaging
---------
All shipped .cls/.rex targets are rexxc-compiled before freeze.
MANIFEST.sha256 is regenerated from the final tree and verified after a fresh
ZIP extraction.
